description: Use this when the user wants a paid Kleap plan, runs out of usage, or needs a feature that requires one (custom domain, more usage). Returns an upgrade_url the USER must open and pay — nothing is charged before that, so never say they are subscribed. plan: 'monthly' (default) or 'annual'; 'credits' (legacy name) buys extra usage for users who already have a paid plan. Do not quote a price: the page shows it in the user's currency.

app_id.description: The site this upgrade is for (shown on the checkout)

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.
